_comment: Generated 2026-04-26 from audit findings (mapping-gap-2026-04-26.md + mapping-remediation-2026-04-26.md) and the proposed-update prompt. Revised same-day after architectural decision: orders now sourced from workOrderWithAdvancedInformationViewEntity (work orders are CTP's natural scheduling unit), NOT salesOrderDetailEntity. See mapping-change-log.md for rationale per rule. NOT yet applied to live config. Several rules use _TODO/_derive placeholders for capabilities the current MappingEngine does not yet support; gaps documented in the change log.
_adapter_note: This mapping assumes the adapter's 'orders' slot is fed from workOrderWithAdvancedInformationViewEntity, not salesOrderDetailEntity. Adapter wiring must be updated alongside applying this mapping — see change log under 'Adapter wiring change required'.

lateDueDate._TODO: engine does not support cross-field references; no late-tolerance field exists in WO schema; placeholder defaults late-due to @dueDate (i.e., zero tolerance) until Stafford specifies a tolerance concept. JobEndDate is a candidate alternative — semantics need confirmation.

mappings._comment_enrichment_fields: Below: customer-facing data from work orders. Useful for UI Gantt labels, filters, etc. Engine doesn't currently consume them.

type._TODO: Stafford confirmation needed — what do R/W/S codes mean operationally? Tentative: R=Resource (machine), W=Work center (pooled), S=Subcontract

class._TODO: engine does not yet support derive; intent: derive class from RessourceType. R -> MACHINE, W -> LABOR_POOL, S -> SUBCONTRACT. Was IsLabour (doesn't exist).

mappings._comment_new_fields: Below are NEW resource attributes surfaced by the audit. Engine doesn't consume them yet; data-layer captures everything.

type._TODO: engine does not yet support derive; intent: derive type from Formula. Tentative: HR/UN -> STANDARD, JR/DY -> DAILY. Stafford confirmation needed — what does Formula encode?

wipState._TODO: engine does not yet support multi-condition derive; intent below. WoStatusCode (3 distinct values) might be a simpler direct rename — see change log open question.

actualStart._TODO: engine does not yet support conditional source selection; intent: use TaskStartDate when IsCompleted=false (in-process) or as the historical actual when IsCompleted=true; null otherwise
